findings.highlight: "…Thank you. That's why I'm really glad to have you as a friend, Io."
findings.evidenceJa:
「…ありがとう。
だから、依緒とは友達でいられたんだろうな」
findings.explanation: Setsuna's conclusion that this is probably why she could remain friends with Io becomes generic gladness to have Io as a friend.
findings.japanese:
「…ありがとう。
だから、依緒とは友達でいられたんだろうな」
findings.todokanai: "…Thank you. That's why I'm really glad to have you as a friend, Io."

findings.highlight: why you've been so down lately
findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜がそんなふうになった理由
findings.explanation: そんなふう refers to the immediately preceding account of Setsuna becoming a friend who keeps part of herself behind walls. Io says Setsuna still has not explained why she became that way; the translation substitutes a recent low mood and changes the topic of the conversation.
findings.japanese:
「結局、雪菜がそんなふうになった理由は、
まだ話してもらってないけど」
findings.todokanai: "That said, Setsuna, you still haven't told me why you've been so down lately."

findings.evidenceJa: 雪菜の気持ちも知らずに先走って
findings.explanation: Io says Haruki rushed ahead without knowing Setsuna's feelings. 'Ignored' means he knew them and willfully disregarded them, materially increasing his culpability and changing the information state on which he acted.
findings.japanese:
「春希が悪いんだから。
あいつが、雪菜の気持ちも知らずに先走って…」
findings.todokanai: "It's all Haruki's fault. He completely ignored your feelings and acted rashly, Setsuna…"

findings.highlight: I already know what it is she's hiding.
findings.evidenceJa: 隠してることがわかっちゃったんだ
findings.explanation: Setsuna realized that Kazusa was hiding something. The Japanese does not say she already knows the concealed content; the translation upgrades detection of concealment into certainty about exactly what is hidden.
findings.japanese:
「かずさ…すごくうまく隠してた。
…でも、隠してることがわかっちゃったんだ」
findings.todokanai: "Kazusa… has been really good at hiding it. But I already know what it is she's hiding."
